<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 120 30% 3%;
  --foreground: 120 100% 60%;
  --card: 120 40% 4%;
  --card-foreground: 120 100% 60%;
  --popover: 120 40% 4%;
  --popover-foreground: 120 100% 60%;
  --muted: 120 40% 7%;
  --muted-foreground: 120 40% 45%;
  --accent: 120 40% 10%;
  --accent-foreground: 120 100% 60%;
  --border: 120 60% 20%;
  --input: 120 60% 25%;
  --ring: 120 100% 60%;
  font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #07200c 0%, #020803 70%);
  color: {{accentColor}};
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-background::after {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
  animation: terminal-flicker 4s steps(1) infinite;
}
@keyframes terminal-flicker {
  0%, 96%, 100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  97% {
    opacity: 0.75;
  }
}
@keyframes terminal-blink {
  50% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 440px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, transparent);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: rgba(2, 14, 4, 0.75);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(2, 14, 4, 0.9), 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent), 0 0 60px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 18%, transparent);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form {
  text-shadow: 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, transparent);
}
.login-logo-box img {
  filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.4) drop-shadow(0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 50%, transparent));
}
.login-logo-box::after {
  content: 'login: _';
  display: block;
  margin-top: 14px;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-size: 13px;
  animation: terminal-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite;
}
.login-logo-box {
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 45%, transparent);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  border-radius: 0;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 65%, transparent);
  font-family: inherit;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: {{accentColor}} !important;
  color: #021004;
  text-shadow: none;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-size: 13px;
  text-transform: lowercase;
}
.login-username label::before,
.login-password label::before {
  content: '$ ';
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 40px;
  padding-left: 22px;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, transparent);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  caret-color: {{accentColor}};
  font-family: inherit;
  text-shadow: inherit;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-username,
.login-password > div {
  position: relative;
}
.login-username::after,
.login-password > div::after {
  content: '>';
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px;
  bottom: 9px;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  pointer-events: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-bottom-style: solid;
  border-bottom-color: {{accentColor}};
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 6%, transparent);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 35%, transparent);
}
.login-password button {
  color: {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border: 1px solid {{accentColor}};
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #021004;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 42px;
  border: 1px solid {{accentColor}};
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent), inset 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 15%, transparent);
}
.login-form .login-button::before {
  content: '[ ';
}
.login-form .login-button::after {
  content: ' ]';
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #021004;
  text-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-signup-link span {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 65%, transparent);
}
#footer {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, transparent);
}
#footer img {
  filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.4);
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
